Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS with deltatime
Metadata.Note: Patch version 2.0 features deltatime. this version will break some things in the game, if that is an issue for you, use the other 60 FPS patch.
Metadata.Author: illusion, u/Charlie_Muggins

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS with fixed tickrate
Metadata.Note: Enables 60 FPS with the engine's builtin way to do it, making this version work with features that break with the other 60 FPS patch enabled.
Metadata.Author: kalaposfos

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Resolution patch (2560x1080)
Metadata.Note: Original for the PS4 made by u/Charlie_Muggins, extended by kalaposfos to work on shadPS4 too
Metadata.Author: u/Charlie_Muggins, kalaposfos

Metadata.Title: Driveclub

Metadata.Author: u/Charlie_Muggins, kalaposfos

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Resolution patch (1920x1200) (16:10)
Metadata.Note: Original for the PS4 made by u/Charlie_Muggins, extended by kalaposfos to work on shadPS4 too. Disclaimer: Aspect ratios narrower than 16:9 will crop the menu.
Metadata.Author: u/Charlie_Muggins, kalaposfos

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Reset Disable
Metadata.Note: Disables reset to track timer
Metadata.Author: ZipperedRain

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Barrier Disable
Metadata.Note: Disables track barriers
Metadata.Author: ZipperedRain

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Disable Photomode Free Camera Collision
Metadata.Note: Disables car collision when using free camera, allowing you to look inside any car.
Metadata.Author: TonySSS

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Disable Photomode Processing
Metadata.Note: Disables photomode processing.
Metadata.Author: TonySSS

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Run without sysmodules
Metadata.Note: Spoofs an error return for a stubbed font function.\nThe game will have no text and will take longer to boot.
Metadata.Author: kalaposfos

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: mac memory allocation workaround
Metadata.Note: Required for the game to boot on Mac. Works on other platforms too, but won't have any real effect there.
Metadata.Author: kalaposfos, squidbus

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Disable motion blur and depth of field
Metadata.Note: They share the same shader, disabling one disables the other
Metadata.Author: Kravickas
